dct_title_s: Pierhead and bulkhead lines, Hackensack River, N.J., from Gas Works Creek to Anderson St. Bridge, Hackensack, Bogota and Teaneck
dct_description_sm: Map showing property and company lines along the Hackensack River, approved by the Department of War
Source map supplied by New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection
Soundings are depths in feet at mean low water
The street systems are compiled from assessment maps of the City of Hackensack, Borough of Bogota and Township of Teaneck.
Map contains inset index map of harbor line maps for Hackensack River at top.
Map contains thirteen inset descriptive diagrams of monuments and reference points in top left corner.
